svg.text: 13 letters + 1 separator = 14 slots per copy. Two copies fill 28 slots, and slot j always matches slot j+14 — so a half turn maps the mark onto itself exactly.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing is distorted: this is ordinary type on a circle. The wheel reading is free, and the hub is available for a monogram, a year, or a rider number.
